text.en: This Order may be cited as the Business Names Act [Amendment) Order, of section 2 of Chapter 92.

Section 2 of the Business Names Act, in this Order referred to as the Act, is (a} in the definition of "Minister", by deleting "Minister of Law" and by substituting "Minister of Finance" therefor; (b} in the definition of "Registrar", by adding ", and includes any Deputy Registrar or Assistant Registrar".

Section 3 of the Act is amended {a} by repealing subsection [1) and by substituting the following new subsection therefor - "(1) His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan shall appoint fit and proper persons to be the Registrar of Business Names, Deputy Registrars and Assistant Registrars of Business Names under and for the purposes of this Act."; {b} by adding the following new 3Ubsection - "(5) Notice of all appointments under subsection (1) shall be published in the Gazette.".
Section 21 of the Act is amended, in subsection j2), by deleting "His Majesty" from the first line and by substituting "the Minister," therefor.

Section 24 of the Act is amended, in subsection (1), by deleting "His Majesty may" from the first line by substituting "The Minister may, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan," therefor. Made this 7th. day of Rabiulawal, 1433 Hijriah corresponding to the 31st. day of January, 2012 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
